theory.heading: What React Testing Library is
theory.body: React Testing Library describes the methods and patterns used within React Full Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: React Testing Library is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why React Testing Library matters
theory.body: Without React Testing Library, systems built with React Full Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How React Testing Library works
theory.body: The mechanism behind React Testing Library follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of React Testing Library.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of React Testing Library
theory.body: React Testing Library offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
